name: Easy Payment Gateway for Razorpay and for WooCommerce
author: Easy Payment

sections.description:
Razorpay by Easy Payment lets Indian businesses accept secure online payments with ease.
Easy Payment is an official Razorpay Partner.

Let your customers pay through India’s most popular payment methods:
✅ UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, BHIM, etc.)
✅ Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, MasterCard, RuPay, etc.)
✅ Netbanking (All major Indian banks)
✅ Wallets (Paytm, PhonePe, Mobikwik, etc.)

🔒 Secure, Reliable, and Optimized for WooCommerce

  • No Redirection: Customers complete their payment directly on your site.
  • Instant Order Updates: Payment confirmations update order status automatically.
  • Fast UPI Checkout: Reduce cart abandonment with instant UPI support.
  • Mobile-Ready: Designed for fast, responsive performance on all devices.

With full Razorpay support, you’ll unlock a modern, flexible payment solution trusted by 100,000+ Indian businesses.

Key Features

✔ PCI DSS Level 1 certified via Razorpay
✔ Accept UPI, cards, netbanking, and wallets
✔ Built for WooCommerce – works out-of-the-box
✔ One-click setup with Razorpay API keys
✔ Auto-update order statuses after successful payment
✔ Fully mobile-compatible and lightning fast
✔ No additional fees – Razorpay’s standard rates apply

How It Works

  1. Install & Activate the plugin.
  2. Enter your Razorpay API Key & Secret in WooCommerce settings.
  3. Enable Razorpay as a payment method in WooCommerce.
  4. Customers can now pay using UPI, Cards, Net Banking, and Wallets securely!

External Services

This plugin uses Razorpay’s secure services to process payments and onboard merchants.

External APIs Used:
– https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js – Renders Razorpay checkout
– https://api.razorpay.com/v1/ – Creates/verifies orders and handles webhooks
– https://rzp.io/ – Used for Razorpay merchant account linking

Data Sent to Razorpay:
– Customer details (name, email, phone)
– Order amount, ID, currency
– Billing and shipping addresses (for payment processing)

Service Provider: Razorpay Software Private Limited
– Privacy Policy
– Terms of Service

Support & Feedback

📩 Need help? Visit our support page.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL-2.0+.
Learn more at GPL License Page.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “Easy Payment Gateway for Razorpay and for WooCommerce”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate the plugin.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
  5. Configure Razorpay with your API credentials and enable the gateway.

You’re all set to start collecting secure payments via Razorpay!
sections.faq:
Do I need a Razorpay account?

Yes, you’ll need a Razorpay merchant account to connect the plugin. Create one here.

Does this plugin support UPI payments?

Absolutely. Customers can pay via UPI apps like Google Pay, PhonePe, and BHIM without redirection.

Is it free to use?

Yes, the plugin is free. Razorpay’s standard transaction fees apply as per your merchant plan.

Will this slow down my site?

No. It’s a lightweight, performance-optimized plugin.

Is payment secure?

Yes! Razorpay is a PCI-compliant and bank-level secure payment gateway.
